value.rationale: The smallest prime exceeding the seven-real-moment dimension is eleven; this gives the first nontrivial constrained prime-grid four-site positive cubature census. Exactly 33 seven-node supports (three translation geometries), each uniquely weighted, provide lossless sampling with four fewer characters than the equal-weight design. A mere existence bound cannot determine the support orbit topology, so the result is a motivated exact finite invariant for structured harmonic frames rather than routine numerical examples.
